items.q: Something like Lawrence Welk is doing, like that

ctx.x: When you say you'd get it shaded, what do you mean.

You read the dynamics, see, you read the dynamics. You didn't know you had to do it, then you'd bring it down and you'd read that and it makes all the sound beautiful, especially when we're playing waltzes and the one waltz we played was the Champagne Waltz. (Humming) Something like Lawrence Welk is doing, like that, and those women with that high class perfume and looking good and that's it.
